content.title: Erin Krakow Is Pregnant! The 'When Calls the Heart' Actress Expecting First Baby with Her Costar Husband Ben Rosenbaum
content.text: The couple, who met on the set of the hit Hallmark series, recently tied the knot in June By Kayla Grant Kayla Grant is a writer-reporter at PEOPLE. She has been working at PEOPLE since 2025. Her work has previously appeared in theGrio, Shondaland and ESSENCE GU. Published on November 26, 2025 03:36PM EST Ben Rosenbaum and Erin Krakow. Credit : Erin Krakow/Instagram (2) NEED TO KNOW Erin Krakow is going to be a mom!The When Calls the Heart actress is expecting her first baby with costar and husband Ben RosenbaumThe actress and her husband shared the exciting news with a joint post on Instagram Erin Krakow is pregnant! The When Calls the Heart actress, 41, is pregnant and expecting her first baby with her costar husband Ben Rosenbaum. The pair announced the exciting news with a joint post on Instagram, showing black-and-white photo booth pictures of them holding the sonogram as they smiled. The couple also enlisted the help of their dog, who wore a "big brother" shirt. "So much to be grateful for!!! 🥰" she wrote in the caption. In the comment section of her announcement post, several of the couple's fellow When Calls the Heart costars shared their congratulations for them and their baby on the way. "Congratulations! What wonderful parents you’ll be! ❤️" commented soon-to-be first-time dad Kevin McGarry, who plays Nathan Grant. Sharing similar sentiments as her husband, McGarry, pregnant Kayla Wallace, who stars as Fiona Miller, wrote, "CRYING! That is going to be one lucky baby 😘." Pascale Hutton, who plays Rosemary LeVeaux-Coulter, also shared her excitement in the comments, writing, "So much love for the 4 of you! ❤️❤️❤️❤️" Krakow and Rosenbaum, 38, who star on Hallmark Channel's long-running drama series as Elizabeth Thatcher and Mike Hickam, respectively, announced via a joint post on Instagram on Monday, June 23, that they had tied the knot. Rosenbaum kept his comment simple, leaving a single infinity symbol emoji: "♾️." Ben Rosenbaum (left) and Erin Krakow. Erin Krakow/Instagram Never miss a story — sign up for PEOPLE's free daily newsletter to stay up-to-date on the best of what PEOPLE has to offer​​, from celebrity news to compelling human interest stories. The couple shared two outdoor wedding photos. In the first photo, Rosenbaum gently kisses Krakow as he rests his hand on her chin. The second shot of the smiling pair was taken further away, allowing their full outfits to be on display. For their big day, Krakow wore a modest satin wedding dress with short sleeves and a long, tulle veil with lace trim topped her curled short hair. Meanwhile, Rosenbaum wore a brown double-breasted suit with a white undershirt. Fellow actors congratulated the couple in the comments section. "Love n stuff ✨🤍✨," Tyler Hynes wrote. "Curls are gorgeous 😍Congrats 💍," commented Tamera Mowry, who tagged the bride.
